purpose: Author one original nonmedical questionnaire as canonical iui/1 JSON. The packing example is synthetic.
requiredSemantics: Keep questionnaireId, explicit definition version, title and hiddenValuePolicy. Sources record provenance only; a URL is not fetched, a permission grant or correctness certification.
Use text, number, choice or boolean fields. Null and empty numeric drafts are unknown. Malformed/out-of-range/off-step input is invalid. False and zero are real answers, never missing substitutes.

visibleWhen may refer only to preceding fields. validWhen may refer to parsed fields, including itself, but not computations. An active unknown dependency makes validation pending even when the rule contains a null guard.
Retain keeps a hidden raw draft locally for revalidation; clear discards it. Both exclude hidden fields from answers, validation and calculations. Hidden expression references resolve to null.

Incomplete or invalid state exposes computed {} and removes previous results immediately. Optional unknown active answers stay null; handle them explicitly with lazy if. Never use zero to fill unknown values.

Expressions are bounded data: add/sub/mul/div/min/max/round/abs/clamp/gt/lt/eq/if/format and {$:name}. Named computation dependencies are allowed, cycles and nonfinite arithmetic are rejected. No JavaScript or formula URL execution.

The cancelable local iui:questionnaire event has {intent:submit|reset,snapshot}. Snapshot answers, validity, computed, version and sources are deeply frozen at one revision; hidden/invalid raw drafts are not included.

Optional named questionnaireActions receive {snapshot,signal}. Editing/reset/update/dispose retires stale completion. No adapter means local acceptance, not persistence or network submission. Preserve cancellation and newer input.

The tested questionnaire source is publicly available at a97a7c13323a91662f758c5c0034e943776935a3 and requires a same-version source build. It is absent from the published214 CDN. Generated domain rules require independent review; the historical212/256 inventory is unchanged.
